newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI not to proceed with Alpic j/v.
newsitem.headline: FAI not to proceed with Alpic j/v.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Friday it would not proceed with its joint venture with Alpic Finance Ltd to seek an insurance licence in India.
FAI said in a statement the companies had ended their joint venture discussion as the privatisation of the Indian market had not eventuated.
The joint venture, announced in August last year with a memorandum of understanding, was subject to due diligence and documentation.
"FAI and Alpic have agreed not to further their joint venture discussions and each company will go their own way," FAI said.
"FAI will maintain its interest in India by opening a respresentative office at the appropriate time," the company said.
